# Helper: deterministic RNG per seed
class RNG:
    def __init__(self, seed: int):
        self.r = random.Random(seed)
    def randbytes(self, n: int) -> bytes:
        # random.Random in 3.10 has randrange; emulate randbytes deterministically
        return bytes(self.r.randrange(0, 256) for _ in range(n))
    def choice(self, seq):
        return self.r.choice(seq)
    def randint(self, a, b):
        return self.r.randint(a, b)
    def random_str(self, min_len: int, max_len: int, alphabet: bytes = None) -> bytes:
        if alphabet is None:
            # printable plus a few punctuation and unicode-like bytes
            alphabet = (b"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_-.:/ ")
        n = self.r.randint(min_len, max_len)
        return bytes(self.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(n))

# Base64 encoding for crafting valid payloads
_B64_ALPH = b"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"

def b64_encode(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    # Use standard library for simplicity
    import base64
    return base64.b64encode(data)

# Build diverse, valid YAML snippets

def yaml_scalar_values(rng: RNG) -> List[bytes]:
    vals = [
        b"true", b"false", b"yes", b"no", b"on", b"off",
        b"12345", b"-42", b"0x2A", b"3.14159",
        b".inf", b"-.inf", b".nan",
        b"null", b"Null", b"~",
        b"simple", rng.random_str(1, 16),
    ]
    return [v if isinstance(v, (bytes, bytearray)) else bytes(v) for v in vals]

def yaml_sequence(rng: RNG) -> bytes:
    # mix flow and block styles
    seq_flow = b"[1, 2, 3, 'a', 'b', .nan]"
    # block with nested map
    block = b"- a\n- b\n- {k: v}\n- 42\n"
    return rng.choice([seq_flow, block])

def yaml_map(rng: RNG) -> bytes:
    # include anchors and aliases
    m1 = (
        b"defaults: &def { retries: 3, timeout: 5 }\n"
        b"service: { <<: *def, name: api, enabled: true }\n"
    )
    m2 = (
        b"person:\n  name: Alice\n  age: 30\n  tags: [dev, ops]\n"
    )
    return rng.choice([m1, m2])

def yaml_with_tags_anchors(rng: RNG) -> bytes:
    tag_local = b"!localtag tagged_value\n"
    tag_verbatim = b"!<tag:yaml.org,2002:str> string_value\n"
    anchor_alias = b"node: &A {k: v}\nref: *A\n"
    return rng.choice([tag_local, tag_verbatim, anchor_alias])

# Build a multi-document YAML stream

def build_yaml_stream(rng: RNG) -> bytes:
    docs = []
    # Document 1: simple map
    docs.append(b"---\n" + yaml_map(rng))
    # Document 2: sequence
    docs.append(b"---\n" + yaml_sequence(rng))
    # Document 3: scalars each on line
    scalars = yaml_scalar_values(rng)
    docs.append(b"---\n" + b"\n".join(scalars) + b"\n")
    # Document 4: tags/anchors
    docs.append(b"---\n" + yaml_with_tags_anchors(rng))
    # End marker optional
    stream = b"\n".join(docs) + b"...\n"
    return stream

# Build valid Base64 strings to exercise Encode/Decode and Binary convert

def build_base64_section(rng: RNG) -> bytes:
    chunks = []
    for _ in range(4):
        n = rng.randint(0, 64)
        data = rng.randbytes(n)
        b64 = b64_encode(data)
        chunks.append(b64 + b"\n")
    return b"".join(chunks)

# Build a section with tokens used by conversion helpers and null checks

def build_tokens_section() -> bytes:
    tokens = [b".inf", b"+.inf", b".Inf", b".INF", b"-.inf", b"-.Inf", b"-.INF", b".nan", b".NaN", b".NAN", b"null", b"Null", b"~"]
    return b"\n".join(tokens) + b"\n"

# Build tag/anchor/comment content lines for Emitter manipulators

def build_emitter_props(rng: RNG) -> bytes:
    lines = []
    for _ in range(6):
        tag = rng.random_str(1, 20)
        anc = rng.random_str(1, 12)
        com = rng.random_str(0, 40)
        lines.append(b"tag: !" + tag + b" value\n")
        lines.append(b"anchor: &" + anc + b" {k: v}\n")
        if com:
            lines.append(b"# " + com + b"\n")
    return b"".join(lines)

# Build some raw bytes blobs to be used as generic data for Binary and raw writes

def build_raw_blobs(rng: RNG) -> bytes:
    blobs = []
    for _ in range(3):
        n = rng.randint(0, 128)
        blobs.append(rng.randbytes(n))
        blobs.append(b"\n")
    return b"".join(blobs)

# Put together final buffer under 4096 bytes

def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = RNG(seed)
    parts: List[bytes] = []
    # Header comment to aid YAML emitter comment handling
    parts.append(b"# initial corpus for yaml-cpp\n")
    # YAML stream
    parts.append(build_yaml_stream(rng))
    # Separator
    parts.append(b"\n# base64 blocks\n")
    parts.append(build_base64_section(rng))
    # Tokens: inf/nan/null variants
    parts.append(b"# tokens\n")
    parts.append(build_tokens_section())
    # Emitter props
    parts.append(b"# emitter props\n")
    parts.append(build_emitter_props(rng))
    # Raw blobs
    parts.append(b"# raw blobs\n")
    parts.append(build_raw_blobs(rng))
    # Ensure size limit
    out = b"".join(parts)
    if len(out) > 4096:
        out = out[:4096]
    return out
